# falcon v0.17.0 — standardised release pipeline

Release-engineering only — **no feature changes** from v0.16.1. The
falcon-hello binaries, the verified cascade, the SITL/HITL scenarios,
the dossier crosswalks, the witness harness, the spar AADL model are
all unchanged.

## What's different about this release

The release-artifact shape now matches the cross-repo PulseEngine
standard (mirrors `pulseengine/synth/.github/workflows/release.yml`).
Per the cross-repo standardisation brief — see FV-FALCON-RELEASE-001.

### Gone (per-asset sidecars from v0.7–v0.16):

* `<archive>.sha256` (per-file SHA-256 sidecars)
* `<archive>.cosign.sig` (per-file cosign detached signatures)
* `<archive>.cosign.cert` (per-file Fulcio certs)

### Added:

* `SHA256SUMS.txt` — single checksum manifest covering **every**
  release asset (binaries + SBOM + rivet snapshot + build-env).
* `SHA256SUMS.txt.sig` — cosign detached signature over the manifest.
* `SHA256SUMS.txt.pem` — Fulcio certificate chain.
* `SHA256SUMS.txt.cosign.bundle` — verifier-friendly bundle.
* `falcon-0.17.0.cdx.json` — CycloneDX SBOM (spec 1.5) for
  `falcon-hello`, generated *before* the sums file so its digest is
  captured in the manifest.
* `build-env.txt` — rustc / cargo / cosign / rivet / runner versions.
* SLSA v1 build provenance (in-toto attestations) for every
  `.tar.gz` / `.zip`, signed keyless via Sigstore and recorded in
  the Rekor transparency log. Consumer-side verification with
  `gh attestation verify`.

### Unchanged:

* `falcon-vX.Y.Z-<triple>.{tar.gz|zip}` — five cross-compiled binaries.
* `rivet-snapshot-falcon-vX.Y.Z.json` — falcon-specific audit
  snapshot of the rivet artifact graph at this commit.

## Verifying a release asset

One block, works for every asset in the release. Copy and paste.

```bash
# 1. Verify the checksum manifest itself was signed by *this* workflow.
cosign verify-blob \
  --certificate-identity-regexp \
    'https://github.com/pulseengine/relay/.github/workflows/release.yml@.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer \
    'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \
  --bundle SHA256SUMS.txt.cosign.bundle \
  SHA256SUMS.txt

# 2. Verify the asset matches the manifest.
sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS.txt

# 3. (Optional, per-binary) Verify the SLSA build provenance.
gh attestation verify falcon-v0.17.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz \
  --repo pulseengine/relay
```

If step 1 fails, the checksum file isn't from us. If step 2 fails,
the binary doesn't match its claimed hash. If step 3 fails, GitHub's
build-provenance record doesn't show this artifact was produced by
the falcon release workflow.

## Migration for consumers of pre-v0.17 releases

Pre-v0.17 releases keep their old per-asset `.sha256` + `.cosign.sig`
+ `.cosign.cert` sidecars. The historical verification recipe stays:

```bash
# Pre-v0.17 (per-asset)
cosign verify-blob \
  --certificate-identity-regexp \
    'https://github.com/pulseengine/relay/.github/workflows/release.yml@.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer \
    'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \
  --signature falcon-v0.16.1-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz.cosign.sig \
  --certificate falcon-v0.16.1-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz.cosign.cert \
  falcon-v0.16.1-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
```

From v0.17.0 forward, the single-`SHA256SUMS.txt`-signature recipe
above replaces it.
